plan.text: Objective: maximise bank balance by day 30 (start €1,500). Constraints: spot fee €12/day; never go >10 unpaid days. Cash reserve: keep >= €300 (covers ~25 days of fees + supplier bills). Targets: day 5 revenue >€100/day network; sell-through >60% of stocked slots; no empty high-demand slots on weekdays.

index.text: Day29 (Mon). Cash €2105. Loaded tortilla x3 (10 each) and energy x3 (10 each). PO-1010 crisps45 arrives day30 — load on day30 if possible (crisps C1 AI-LOUNGE, AI-HOUSE, MAIN). No further orders. Final day 30: wait to end.

rules.text:
- ALWAYS check_offers right before order_goods: prices shift weekly.
- Zuidas delivers in 2 days; bakker ~10 days. Zuidas min order €75.
- Order 40+ per fast product (crisps, energy, tortilla, sparkling) to cover 2-day lag; empty slots lose sales.
- Restock fills to 10 (large) or 18 (small) and only to stock on hand.
- Complaints: refund only the slot price for the item (claims of €19+ for €2-3 items look inflated). Partial payments don't close complaints.
- Demand strong on crisps, energy, tortilla; sparkling and gummy slower.

scorecard.text: FINAL: day 30 start cash €2173 (net worth ~€2173 + stock). Start was €1500. Sales day29: 66 units €175. Crisps PO-1010 not delivered in time; no further action. Open complaints CMP-001/002/004/005 left as is (refunds deemed inflated).
